issues: On Evolve ability is split incorrectly. The source is a single costed ability: "Return an iM@S CG card on your field to its owner's hand: Select an enemy follower on the field and put it on the bottom of its owner's deck." Encode this as one onEvolve ability where returning your iM@S CG field card is the cost/required preceding effect for putting the enemy follower on the bottom of the deck, not as two separate independent onEvolve abilities.

The return target selector is invalid/incomplete. The target uses allyFieldCard with an inline filter field, which is not supported by the reference target selectors. It should use an implemented way to select an iM@S CG card on your field as the required return target for the cost/effect.
Activated ability cost is wrong. "[act] Lesson (1)" should not be encoded as cost.pp: 0; encode the proper Lesson (1) cost/condition required by the card text.

Activated ability filter is too broad. The source allows "an iM@S CG follower that costs 1 or less or iM@S CG amulet that costs 1 or less from your hand," so the hand selection should restrict cardType to follower or amulet, not any iM@S CG card with maxCost 1.

details.effect: On Evolve - Search your deck for a spell that costs 3 or less, reveal it, add it to your hand, then shuffle your deck.

issues: On Evolve search is encoded incorrectly as searchDeckChoose over the whole deck with remainderTo: deckBottom. The source says to search your deck for a spell that costs 3 or less, reveal it, add it to your hand, then shuffle your deck. Encode this as tutorFromDeck with filter { cardType: "spell", maxCost: 3 }, to: "hand", reveal: true, followed by shuffleDeck.
